script.title: A Lions first-round pick chose the Marines instead. Then ⚔️
sentences: Dave Schreiner turned down the Detroit Lions to join the Marines.
He was a two-time All-American at Wisconsin.
On Christmas Eve 1944, Marines on Guadalcanal set up a football game.
Sixty-five of them played, many former college stars.
It's the Mosquito Bowl, the real game behind the new Netflix film.
All that talent, and it ended 0 to 0.
On Okinawa, Tony Butkovich, who had led the nation in rushing, was killed in April 1945.
Both had been the 11th overall pick of an NFL draft, and neither came home.
script.description:
Two first-round NFL picks played one last game on Guadalcanal.
The true story behind Netflix's The Mosquito Bowl.
claims_en: Dave Schreiner was a first-round draft choice of the Detroit Lions in 1943 and served in the Marines instead of playing in the NFL
Schreiner was a two-time All-American at Wisconsin
The Mosquito Bowl was played December 24, 1944, on Guadalcanal between two regiments of Marines
Sixty-five players took part; many had played college football and been named All-America or all-conference
Netflix released the film The Mosquito Bowl in 2026
The game ended in a scoreless tie
Tony Butkovich led the nation in rushing in 1943 and was killed in action at Okinawa on April 18, 1945
Schreiner was mortally wounded during the Battle of Okinawa and died on June 21, 1945
Both were #11 overall NFL draft picks (Schreiner 1943, Butkovich 1944)
Both died in the Battle of Okinawa

US Marines in 1944 khaki uniforms marking out a rough football field on a dusty tropical island, palm trees, Christmas Eve sunset, wide shot

Marines in the crowd swatting mosquitoes and grinning as a pileup happens on the dusty field, humid golden light, medium shot
A hand-painted wooden scoreboard reading only zeros at dusk beside the dirt field, tired players walking off with helmets in hand, soft orange light, medium shot
Marines in 1945 combat uniforms wading ashore toward a green hilly island under a grey sky, landing craft behind them, solemn tone, wide shot, no violence shown
A folded US flag and a leather football resting on a wooden crate in a quiet field tent, soft morning light, still life close-up
Two empty vintage leather football helmets side by side on a dirt field at sunset, long shadows, quiet and somber, close-up
